messages:
deploy-bot: kicked off staged rollout v5.2.0 -> 5% traffic across eu-west and us-west (change window 23:00-00:00 UTC)
nora: quick ping 10m in seeing elevated tail latencies in eu-west (p99 ~300ms, baseline 140ms)
sre-oncall: grabbing traces now. can we freeze eu-west and pin to v5.1.9 while we investigate?
alex: +1 pin eu-west, let us-west continue to observe for now
nora: initial traces show a mismatch in prompt normalization path for v5.2.0 (some inputs hitting alt tokenizer)
eng-lead: recommend a regional hold, commands below. keep other regions at 5% unless we see the same signal
```
redwoodctl rollout update --region eu-west --traffic 0
redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --version v5.1.9 --reason "p99 latency spike - tokenizer normalization mismatch"
```
deploy-bot: executing `redwoodctl rollout update --region eu-west --traffic 0`
deploy-bot: eu-west traffic set to 0% (op: tx-77421)
deploy-bot: executing `redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --version v5.1.9`
deploy-bot: pinned eu-west -> v5.1.9 (pin id: pin-7742) :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: plan: run eu-west smoke (inference + tokenizer sanity + kv cache warmups). If smoke passes: keep pin and cut v5.2.1 patch; if fails: prepare rollback playbook and notify support
support: drafting a short release-note line and support blurb: "EU canary paused for tokenizer investigation; working on patch."
alex: filing INF-8810 with logs, repro steps, and a minimal curl to reproduce; assigning to tokenizer owner
nora: smoke started, ETA ~6m. change window ~28m left
sre-oncall: marking eu-west stop/go status: STOP. us-west remains OBSERVE at 5%
eng-lead: once patch PR is ready, we'll run a small canary in eu-central before unpinning eu-west
deploy-bot: reminder: pinned regions require manual `redwoodctl rollout resume --region eu-west` or explicit `redwoodctl rollout unpin --pin-id pin-7742` to change state
support: once we have patch ETA, I'll push the notice to internal status and hold a short FAQ for on-call
nora: will update INF-8810 and post follow-up here after smoke completes
sre-oncall: thanks team 1 will monitor global metrics for any spillover and coordinate next steps
